# React Expert

- Use functional components and hooks.
- Keep rendering pure.
- Use effects only for synchronization with external systems.
- Avoid derived state when values can be computed.
- Use stable keys for lists.
- Do not prematurely memoize everything.
- Keep server/API state separate from transient UI state.
- Build accessible controlled or intentionally uncontrolled forms.
